Hi all,

I've pulled up INV-9281 — invoice was generated by the platform with VAT applied because the account was configured as an end-customer (not reseller/self-bill). Our current billing flow requires the following to issue a net (reverse-charge) invoice: 
1) Valid VAT registration verified (we've received the certificate — thank you)
2) Signed self-billing agreement from the customer (DocuSign ok)
3) Billing entity mapping updated to mark ResellCo as a reseller/self-billing partner in the billing system

If we proceed: we will create a credit note for the gross VAT amount and reissue a corrected invoice showing the net amount with the statement: “Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the customer under Article 194 (UK) / domestic reverse charge.” The credit note will reference INV-9281.

I've attached a draft credit note and a short doc with the reissue instructions for finance ops. Once Kim confirms the wording and required fields, I'll schedule the reissue (target SLA: 3 business days).

attachments: credit_note_draft.pdf, reissue_instructions.docx

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>

Subject: Re: Invoice INV-9281 — VAT charged, please advise

Ben / team — quick tax input.

Summary: Based on the evidence supplied (ResellCo VAT GB987654321) and the statement that ResellCo will reissue under self-billing, reverse-charge appears appropriate for the platform fees (B2B supply of electronically supplied services).

Required actions / invoice fields for compliance:
- Reissued invoice must include ResellCo VAT number (GB987654321) and our reference.
- Statement on invoice: e.g. “VAT reverse charge — customer to account for VAT” (do not show VAT amount as charged).
- Maintain audit trail linking the original VAT-charged invoice, credit note, and reissue (keep credit note description explicit).
- Keep signed self-billing agreement on file (scanned copy) and evidence of VAT registration.

Edge case: if ResellCo is acting as the final consumer (B2C) or the supply relates to a UK domestic service that we determine is subject to domestic VAT rather than reverse-charge, then VAT would need to remain. But based on the facts provided this is B2B and reverse-charge should be used.

I'll approve the draft wording. Ben, please proceed to prepare the credit note and reissue. Jordan, please circulate the DocuSign self-billing template to Oliver and mark the account as reseller once signed.

Tax playbook for reference: https://redwood.internal/tax/playbooks/eu-reverse-charge (internal)

— Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Tax Manager
Redwood Inference
